definition.uncertainty: Methods for systematically identifying reasoning blind spots without external oracle guidance remain unverified.

assumptions: Reasoning limitations manifest as unstable or contradictory outputs under prompt perturbation.
Internal state monitoring can surface divergence before explicit failure.
definition.falsification: High stability under perturbation despite fundamental reasoning errors indicates prompt topology perturbation is insufficient to surface blind spots.
definition.statement: An autonomous agent can detect logical inconsistencies in its own blind spots by comparing outputs generated across perturbed prompt topologies.
definition.uncertainty: The sensitivity of perturbation-based detection to superficial wording changes rather than deep reasoning limits is currently unknown.
